title: Farik RPC
description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 text frames between the browser and the daemon's GET /rpc (docs/SPEC.md section 8). Any frame is a request, a response, or a notification; the query results and the command reply are $defs, which name the shape of each answer. command and event are objects here, not references, because one schema never references another: command_from_value and event_from_value read them.

requestId.description: The caller's own number for a request, echoed by its response.

command.description: A command wire of command.schema.json; the daemon validates it with command_from_value.

rpcRequest.title: Rpc Request
rpcRequest.description: What the browser sends. The pairing of a query's name with its params is the schema's; the meaning of a command is command_from_value's.

result.description: emptyResult for subscribe and unsubscribe, commandReply for command, the query's own result def for query, and the method's own result def (projectOpenResult, projectCreateResult, accountConnectResult, sandboxBuildResult, browserPullResult) for a setup method, and each other method's own result def.

id.description: null when the request's id could not be read.

rpcError.title: Rpc Error
rpcError.description: -32700 parse, -32600 invalid request, -32601 unknown method, -32602 invalid params, -32603 internal (the store or a file failed), -32001 unknown_query, -32002 not_found, -32003 refused_here, -32004 no_project (the daemon has no project yet, so it answers only the setup queries), -32005 refused (a setup method was refused; the message is the sentence to show).

rpcNotification.title: Rpc Notification
rpcNotification.description: The server's push of one event. The event is an object here because one schema never references another; rpc_notification_from_value reads it with event_from_value.

commandReply.title: Command Reply
commandReply.description: What the daemon's POST /command answers once the token passes (docs/SPEC.md section 8.2): what the command did, as one sentence and the sequence numbers of the events it appended, or why it did nothing. A reply is what leaves a process, so it has a schema as a command does; farik_protocol::command::reply_from_value reads it against this definition.

kind.description: invalid: the command cannot be handled as given, a schema refusal among them; refused: it cannot be done to what it names as things stand; not_found: what it names is not there; failed: the store, a file, git, or the orchestrator failed.

design_plan.description: The task's latest UI/UX Designer's plan and the Product Manager's decision on it (ADR 0026), or null when no plan was proposed. reason is the decision's, once there is one.

ui_change.description: Whether the task's change touches the interface (ADR 0026): a Software Developer's task whose contract sets ui_change, or whose branch changes a path the team's ui_paths match.

design_review.description: The UI/UX Designer's design review of the change (step 12), or null when it is not a UI change. state says where it stands; reasons and checks are the latest design_review.recorded since the task last entered verifying, when there is one.

design_reviews.description: Every design_review.recorded of the task, oldest first: the Designer that recorded it, whether it passed, its reasons, and when (step 12). The gate reads the earlier ones as the Designer's send-backs, and the latest as who signed the letter.

team.description: The team file as team.schema.json shapes it.

max_agents.description: The most agents a team may have that are not retired (spec 4.1).

project_root.description: null while the daemon is in setup mode, before a project is chosen.

take_on_error.description: Why taking the chosen project on failed, or null.

setup_pending.description: Whether the project was just set up and waits for the team's setup (the marker .farik/local/setup-pending).

design_review_state.description: tasks.list only, for a task in verifying whose change is to the interface: task.get's design_review.state, so the board need not ask each card (step 12).

taskProjection.description: One row of the board (farik_store::TaskProjection). Optional fields are absent, not null, when the projection has none.

designer_browser.description: The UI/UX Designer's browser, the Playwright connector's pinned image; present only for a team with a Designer, which setup's suggested team has (step 12).

environment_variable.description: The variable the credential comes from, when it comes from the environment: Farik cannot remove it, so the page names it rather than offering Disconnect.

key_refused.description: True while the team is paused because the model provider refused the credential (docs/SPEC.md 5.5): the key did not work, and connecting the account again resumes the team. Left out otherwise.

taking_on.description: True when a project that waited on the credential is now being taken on, so the daemon restarts on it.

browserPullRequest.title: Browser Pull Request
browserPullRequest.description: Setup pulls the UI/UX Designer's browser, the Playwright connector's image, by its pinned digest (step 12).

contract.description: A contract as task-contract.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

taskScreenshotQuery.title: Task Screenshot Query
taskScreenshotQuery.description: A screenshot farik_check_page took of the task's preview (step 12): file is the name one of the task's page.checked events gives, and any other name is not_found.

requestFileRequest.title: Request File Request
requestFileRequest.description: Files the person's words as a draft request. Answers requestFileResult; a refusal of words under 20 characters carries data with errors, each a path, a message and a code, the code too_short, as team.validate answers them.

text.description: The request in the person's words: its first line is the title, and the whole is the intent. The daemon refuses a text under 20 characters.

contract.description: A contract as task-contract.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

waitingListResult.description: What waits on the human, questions first, then approvals, other escalations, acceptances, and integrations; then the UI changes whose design review waits for the team's preview (preview_missing) or for Docker's sandbox (designer_needs_sandbox).

contract.description: A contract as task-contract.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

contractCheckResult.description: The rules an unsaved plan fails: schema errors first, as rule schema, then the Definition of Ready's; total is the number of checks run, the schema counting as one.

taskDiffResult.description: A task's diff against the integration branch, or an epic's tasks' integrated diffs joined in id order, each under a # FRK-n line.

taskChecksResult.description: Each criterion's latest result since the task last entered verifying; for a plan awaiting approval, the Definition of Ready's failures, each named by its rule.

taskTriesResult.description: The try in progress, iteration + 1, of max_iterations + 1 plus the extra tries granted: the limit bounds returns, and the pass after the last return is a try too.

sprintCurrentResult.description: The open sprint and how many of its tasks are done (accepted or cancelled), or null when none is open.

escalationChoicesResult.description: What the human may do about an escalation: each choice's label and the command the page sends, to which it adds the message.

contractSaveResult.description: The human's edit is saved; back_to_refining says a frozen plan went back to refining, to be checked and approved again.

taskCostsResult.description: What a task has spent, by the purposes' plain words (Planning: triage, refine, plan; Building: implement; Checking: verify; Meetings and talk: ceremony, conversation), each word that has spent anything, and its contract's limit.

sprintRow.description: A sprint: its file, who started it (sprint.started), the first assigner that planned it (null when only Farik did), what it spent, and how many of its tasks are done (accepted or cancelled).

sprintGetResult.description: sprintRow's fields, its tasks, and its meetings: the ceremony posts from its start until the next sprint starts, one meeting per ceremony session, oldest first.

costsSummaryResult.description: Today's spending (UTC) and the team's daily limit, the last sprint's (the open one while one is), and each agent's that is not retired, in the team's order.

metricsResult.description: The harness metrics of F17, over the project or one sprint; a rate is null while no task is accepted.

teamProposeQuery.title: Team Propose Query
teamProposeQuery.description: The team setup suggests: the team as it is with the five suggested agents in place of its own, and the criterion library as it is, which the setup form edits beside it.

teamValidateQuery.title: Team Validate Query

team.description: A team as team.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

teamValidateQuery.description: A changed team checked and described before it is saved (docs/SPEC.md section 10). Nothing is written.

modelsListQuery.title: Models List Query
modelsListQuery.description: The newest model of each family the price table prices, with the words a person reads for it.

teamSaveRequest.title: Team Save Request
teamSaveRequest.description: Writes the team when it has no errors and appends team.updated. It refuses a status change (an agent is paused, retired or resumed from its card) and removing an agent the log has seen work from. Answers emptyResult; a refusal's data holds errors, each a path, a message and a code, as team.validate answers them.

team.description: A team as team.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

teamStartRequest.title: Team Start Request
teamStartRequest.description: The setup form's Start the team: writes the team and the criteria, removes the setup marker, and appends team.updated, criteria.updated and, when the marker was there and the team is paused, team.resumed: without the marker a paused team stays paused. While the marker is there it may replace the starter team's agents. Answers emptyResult.

team.description: A team as team.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

criteria.description: A criterion library as criteria.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

criteriaSaveRequest.title: Criteria Save Request
criteriaSaveRequest.description: Writes the criterion library when it is one and appends criteria.updated. Answers emptyResult.

criteria.description: A criterion library as criteria.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

accountDisconnectRequest.title: Account Disconnect Request
accountDisconnectRequest.description: Deletes the AI account's credential from every store that holds it and, when one did, pauses the team. A credential from the environment cannot be removed: nothing is deleted, and the answer names its variable.

team.description: A team as team.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

criteria.description: A criterion library as criteria.schema.json shapes it; the daemon validates it.

unavailable.description: The proposed agents this computer cannot run, which setup shows unticked: the UI/UX Designer, with designer_needs_sandbox, where Farik runs without Docker's sandbox (step 12, D3).

code.description: The refusal as the page words it for a person; the message is for a log, and invalid is any refusal with no words of its own.

effects.description: Each effect of the change in plain words; empty when there are errors.

agents.description: The team as it would be, as team.get answers it; left out when there are errors.

judges.description: Left out when there are errors.

paused.description: Whether this call paused the team: true only when a credential was removed and the team was running. A team already paused stays paused and answers false.

environment_variable.description: The variable the credential comes from, when it comes from the environment and so could not be removed.

projectScanQuery.title: Project Scan Query
projectScanQuery.description: The project scanned again, as the setup screen "What we found" reads it back in rows. Nothing is written.

projectNoteRequest.title: Project Note Request
projectNoteRequest.description: Something is wrong: the user's words kept in .farik/project.md under "The user says", which every rescan carries across. Answers emptyResult.

text.description: What the user says about the project, in their own words.

language.description: The language with the most tracked files.

workspace.description: Whether the project is a workspace.

packages.description: How many packages the workspace has.

tests_in.description: Where the tests are, as a location.

last_commit.description: How long ago the last commit was, in words; null before the first commit.

checks.description: The text of each check the scan found in the project's own commands.

kept_private.description: The protected-path globs that match something on disk, walked four folders deep without .git and node_modules, over at most 2000 entries.

agentReplaceRequest.title: Agent Replace Request
agentReplaceRequest.description: Replace: the agent retired and a newcomer added, in one validated change to the team file, so that a team is never left without the role the agent held. Appends agent.updated, then team.updated. Answers emptyResult; a refusal's data holds errors, each a path, a message and a code, as team.validate answers them, as team.save's does.

newcomer.description: The agent that joins, as team.schema.json shapes an agent; the daemon validates the team it makes.

effectiveAgent.title: Effective Agent
effectiveAgent.description: An agent as its sessions run: its model and effort (its own, or else its role's), the model's words, the tiers it holds, and base_tiers, those its role and the team's permission answers give it before its own grants and revokes.

label.description: The family's words, with (older) when a newer one of the family is priced; the id when no family names it.

planJudges.title: Plan Judges
planJudges.description: Who checks plans under each choice of policy.judgment.judge: the first active agent of the role, and under auto the one Team::judge resolves (spec 5.3); null where no active agent holds it.

settingsDefaultsQuery.title: Settings Defaults Query
settingsDefaultsQuery.description: What putting a setting back puts back (spec 10): farik_core::team::defaults(), the same values farik init writes.

budgets.description: The team's budgets as team.schema.json shapes them, with no daily limit.

policy.description: The starter policy, with the plan check and the permission answers written out.

rules.description: The rules the team adds to Farik's; none by default.

ui_paths.description: The UI paths every team starts with (spec 5.12): a Software Developer's change that touches one is design-reviewed.

channelMessagesQuery.title: Channel Messages Query
channelMessagesQuery.description: The team channel's newest page of messages before before_seq, or the newest of all without it (spec 5.9).

channelMessagesResult.description: One page of message.posted, oldest first within the page: seq and at from the envelope, task_id the task the message is about, and the body's fields, thread and in_reply_to null when it has none.
